title: The Speaker's Attitude: ときたら, といい…といい, といわず…といわず, だの…だの, に言わせれば, にしたって, といったところだ
description: Complaining about someone, praising every aspect, everywhere without exception, grumbling lists, according to someone, even (casual), and 'about, at most'.

points.title: 〜ときたら: when it comes to (complaint)
points.summary: Noun + ときたら = talking about A (with frustration).
points.body: - うちの息子**ときたら**、毎日ゲームばかりしている.
examples: この{部屋|へや}ときたら、{狭|せま}いし{暗|くら}いし……
This room, honestly — cramped and dark …

points.title: A といい B といい: both A and B
points.summary: Picking examples to give one overall judgement (praise or criticism).
points.body: - 味**といい**値段**といい**、この店は最高だ.
examples: デザインといい{色|いろ}といい、{文句|もんく}なしだ。
The design, the colour — no complaints at all.

points.title: A といわず B といわず: everywhere
points.summary: A といわず B といわず = not just A or B — everywhere / all the time.
points.body: - 昼**といわず**夜**といわず**働いている.
examples: {手|て}といわず{足|あし}といわず、{泥|どろ}だらけだ。
Hands, feet, everywhere — covered in mud.

points.title: A だの B だの: A and B and so on (grumbling)
points.summary: Listing complaints or excuses. やれ A だの、やれ B だの.
points.body: - 忙しい**だの**疲れた**だの**、文句ばかり言う.
examples: やれ{仕事|しごと}だの、やれ{会議|かいぎ}だの、{休|やす}む{暇|ひま}もない。
What with work and meetings, there's no time to rest.

points.title: 〜に言わせれば: if you ask (someone)
points.summary: Person + に言わせれば = in that person's opinion.
points.body: - 専門家**に言わせれば**、この計画には無理がある.
examples: {母|はは}に{言|い}わせれば、{私|わたし}はまだ{子供|こども}だそうだ。
According to my mother, I'm still a child.

points.title: 〜にしたって: even (casual)
points.summary: Noun + にしたって = casual にしても: even A ….
points.body: - 先生**にしたって**、すべての答えを知っているわけではない.
examples: {私|わたし}にしたって、{初|はじ}めはわからなかったよ。
Even I didn't get it at first.

points.title: 〜といったところだ: about, at most
points.summary: Number / noun + といったところだ = roughly, no more than.
points.body: - 参加者は多くて三十人**といったところだ**.
examples: {合格|ごうかく}の{可能性|かのうせい}は五{分|ぶ}五{分|ぶ}といったところだ。
The chance of passing is about fifty-fifty.

questions.prompt: うちの{息子|むすこ}（　）、{毎日|まいにち}ゲームばかりしている。
questions.explanation: When it comes to (complaint): **ときたら**.
questions.translation: My son, honestly — all he does is play games.

questions.prompt: What does 「この{部屋|へや}ときたら、{狭|せま}いし{暗|くら}いし……」 mean?
options: When I came to this room, it was small.
This room is small but bright.
This room, honestly — cramped and dark …
notes: ときたら isn't 'when I came'.

questions.prompt: {味|あじ}（　）{値段|ねだん}といい、この{店|みせ}は{最高|さいこう}だ。
questions.explanation: Both A and B: **といい…といい**.
questions.translation: The taste, the price — this place is the best.

questions.prompt: What does 「デザインといい{色|いろ}といい、{文句|もんく}なしだ。」 mean?
options: If the design and colour are good, there are no complaints.
The design, the colour — no complaints at all.
Say the design and colour, and nothing else.
Speaking of design and colour, I have complaints.
questions.explanation: といい…といい = **both … and (overall judgement)**.
notes: It's a judgement, not a condition.

questions.prompt: {彼|かれ}は{昼|ひる}（　）{夜|よる}といわず{働|はたら}いている。
questions.explanation: Everywhere / all the time: **といわず…といわず**.

questions.prompt: What does 「{手|て}といわず{足|あし}といわず、{泥|どろ}だらけだ。」 mean?
options: He didn't say hands or feet.
Hands, feet, everywhere — covered in mud.
Only his hands and feet are muddy.
Not his hands or feet, but the rest is muddy.
notes: いわず here isn't a negation of mud.

questions.prompt: {彼女|かのじょ}は{忙|いそが}しい（　）{疲|つか}れただの、{文句|もんく}ばかり{言|い}う。
notes: やら pairs with やら.
とか pairs with とか.
なり pairs with なり.
questions.translation: She's always complaining — she's busy, she's tired …

questions.prompt: やれ{仕事|しごと}（　）、やれ{会議|かいぎ}だの、{休|やす}む{暇|ひま}もない。
notes: なり doesn't pair with だの.
や doesn't pair with だの.
questions.translation: What with work and meetings, there's no time to rest.

questions.prompt: {専門家|せんもんか}（　）、この{計画|けいかく}には{無理|むり}がある。
questions.explanation: In someone's opinion: **に言わせれば**.
notes: を言わせて isn't the pattern.
questions.translation: According to the experts, this plan is unrealistic.

questions.prompt: What does 「{母|はは}に{言|い}わせれば、{私|わたし}はまだ{子供|こども}だそうだ。」 mean?
options: I told my mother I'm still a child.
My mother made me say I'm still a child.
My mother is still a child.
According to my mother, I'm still a child.
questions.explanation: に言わせれば = **in someone's view**.

questions.prompt: {先生|せんせい}（　）、すべての{答|こた}えを{知|し}っているわけではない。
notes: にあたって = 'on the occasion of'.
questions.translation: Even teachers don't know all the answers.

questions.prompt: What does 「{私|わたし}にしたって、{初|はじ}めはわからなかったよ。」 mean?
options: I made it so you didn't understand.
Even I didn't get it at first.
For me, it was clear from the start.
notes: わからなかった = didn't understand.

questions.prompt: {参加者|さんかしゃ}は{多|おお}くて{三十人|さんじゅうにん}（　）。
questions.explanation: About, at most: **といったところだ**.
notes: ということだ = 'I hear / that means'.
というものだ = 'that's what … is'.
questions.translation: There'll be thirty participants at most.

questions.prompt: What does 「{合格|ごうかく}の{可能性|かのうせい}は五{分|ぶ}五{分|ぶ}といったところだ。」 mean?
options: The chance of passing is exactly fifty percent.
They said the chance was fifty-fifty.
The chance of passing is about fifty-fifty.
